steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Who bound my arms and legs? Oh yes, it's those armored soldiers who restrained me.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: The FAC? Oh, I remember now. I'm in a hospital, and so is Carley.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Where is Cabernet? Why is she not here?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Unable to move... it's a familiar feeling. I thought she had got us again...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: You worked late again, huh? What do you want for dinner? I've got some ingredients from one of the neighbors. How about I make your favorite dish—Roast Stuffed Mushrooms?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Let me share some news with you first. Good news and bad news. Which one do you want to hear first?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Um, the bad news.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: The manager of the Réver Hotel told me that they didn't need a new cook for the time being.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: No surprise there. Must've been my Syndican origins again, right?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: (Sighs) How many now for this month?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Thirteen, fourteen, I've lost count.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Just because Syndicate is plagued with Mania and gangsters, doesn't mean every Syndican has a violent streak.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: It's all right. We'll keep looking. Earning a living in Eastside as a Syndican, I never expected it to be easy. And even if I can't find a job in a high-end restaurant, I can still do what I'm doing now, working part-time for roadside diners.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Eastside is so big and so prosperous. I'm sure we'll find our place here sooner or later.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: You graduated with distinction from DisCity Blue Ribbon Culinary School. Working in those roadside diners is a huge waste of your talent. We'll find a way to get you a decent job.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Check this out!
Carley withdraws a piece of paper from her bag, smoothing out its curled corners with care.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Application for Employment as Cabernet Franc's Private Chef? This is your good news, right?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Franc. Isn't this the family you work for?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Yeah. I heard about the job opening from the butler. Miss Franc is a picky eater. She has been looking for a cook, but with no luck.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: You're a talented cook. You were one of the top students at DisCity Blue Ribbon Culinary School. Just give this a go. Have faith in yourself!

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Cooking for a princess of a wealthy family... This might be more demanding than working in a restaurant.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: I don't know much about her personality. But I hear she doesn't care about a candidate's origins, as long as the candidate is good at the job. So I'd guess she's...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: A decent person.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: I beg your pardon.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The smell of Number 787.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: This, well let's call it a dish. This dish prepared by this Greg guy tastes interesting. It reminds me of the smell that fills my nose whenever I walk past Number 787. I've never tasted anything like this before.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Number 787. The garbage-processing plant?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: I-it can't be. This is his best dish. Maybe it's because you ate something else early, and the tastes got mixed up. Please do try it again.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: He put his heart and soul into this dish.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Heart and soul? Sorry, but I don't get that impression from this dish.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Or if by heart and soul, you mean the smell of Number 787, then yes, I do get the impression.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Carley! How dare you throw your employer's plate?

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: I recommended Greg out of the goodness of my heart. And this is how you repaid me, by being rude to your employer?

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Sorry, I... I didn't mean it. It's just that this meant the world to Greg. Even if you didn't like it, you shouldn't have called it...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Called it garbage.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Enough! You Syndicans are all the same, a bunch of thugs with no self-control. We shouldn't have hired you in the first place!

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Get out! Your services are no longer needed!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: I apologize for my earlier behavior, Miss Cabernet. But you didn't really try the dish. It's kind of disrespectful to the cook.

Carley looks down at the shards on the floor and then up at the dish on the table; Cabernet sampled only the sauce of the dish. The butler is trying to pull Carley away from the table, but she doesn't budge.
She's not being entirely reasonable right now. She knows that. But she also knows, without a shadow of a doubt, that Greg's dish deserves a much better reception.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Carley. That's your name, right?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It has a nice ring to it. Palatable, just like the way you smell.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Palatable?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Let her stay. She intrigues me.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Carley? Why is she here? Wh-what happened to her?

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: What did you do to her?!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I cherished her. Her soul is a treasure trove of deliciousness.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: You're crazy!
Greg shoves Cabernet out of the way to get to Carley. Cabernet doesn't take offense at his "rudeness."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I remember you. You're Greg, the cook.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Not as good, but good enough.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: You don't deserve my food. Stay away from us, you crazy woman! Let Carley go!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're mistaken. When I said "good enough," I didn't mean your food.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: What?!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You, the love of her life, also have a pure, vibrant soul. The souls of you two are like nothing I've encountered before.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Stay. I'll make sure that the two of you live happily and never have to leave each other's side.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: As long as your souls remain to my taste, I'll always...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Cherish you with all my heart. I won't...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Consume every bit of you all at once and reduce you to empty shells.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's not enough. I want more. I want something even more delicious...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Take this. It's your soul. It tastes like desire.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: What?!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You, the love of her life, also have a pure, vibrant soul. The souls of you two are like nothing I've encountered before.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Take this. It's your soul. It tastes like desire.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Why did that demon give me these Soul Grapes? Ah, I've got it...

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: A soulless me and a greedy you would have no value to her.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: This is our only way out. This is the only way to free ourselves from those painful memories that never end.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Come, Carley, eat this, eat my soul. This is the ultimate dish I made for you.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: Eat all the grapes. Don't leave any for Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Greg
steps.content: We are free.
The patients' actions after they came to take everyone else in the room by surprise. The FAC guards move in to stop them, and you activate the shackles, but it's too late.
Forced by Greg, Carley has consumed his entire extracted soul.
Greg has sacrificed every last bit of himself to free the love of his life, or so he thought.

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Mr. Greg! Can you hear me, Mr. Greg?

steps.speaker: FAC Clerk
steps.content: Guards, separate them! Protect the Chief! Come on!!!
No one expected this would happen. The sickroom is in total chaos. Cabernet, who has come to meet Greg, gets out of the way of the moving guards and sits down.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We are too late. Cabernet, why is it that you didn't look surprised at all?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You knew this would happen, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I used my power to help him extract his soul and taught him a trick or two. But I never made him do this...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It was his own choice. He did this of his own volition. And he wanted me to see it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: He wanted you to see it, or you wanted me to see it?
She doesn't contradict you. If anything, she seems eager to hear whatever you have to say next.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The last time I met Greg in this sickroom, he was desperate to prove he was worthless to you, desperate to be freed from your control.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now he's proved it, at your instigation. At the same time, you have lost an "ingredient."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A gourmet like you would never give up a precious ingredient without a good reason. You encouraged him to feed his soul to Carley, and then led me here to witness his unraveling.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You did all this on my account. This is the...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Main course.
She finishes your sentence, raises her cane, and playfully rests its tip against your chest.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Sharp, perceptive, intelligent, honest, kind... Your soul tastes divine. I wish I had met you sooner.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I can't begin to tell you how much I love this helpless look on your face.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've been your target all along. Your promise—that you would never feed on other people's souls, was just a lie. It meant nothing to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you did all this just to anger me, to make me more to your taste, then congratulations, you succeeded.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You want to consume my soul. Be my guest. But don't drag another innocent person into this.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hahaha... Sounds like you really are angry. But we've just started on the "main course."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you mean? Greg is unconscious. Isn't that enough for you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Of course it isn't enough. I'm gonna show you something that will make your soul more enticing.
She lifts your chin and turns your head in Carley's direction.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Here, see for yourself. Souls can be irresistibly delicious; no one knows this better than me.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: How strange...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: The thing I just ate was in the shape of a bunch of grapes, but it tastes like roast stuffed mushrooms.

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: My favorite dish...

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: It's delicious. It gave me a familiar, warm feeling. I want more, more!

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: Where can I find more? <size=45>I haven't had enough! Not enough at all!</size>

steps.speaker: Carley
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=50>I want more! Give me more!</size>  </color>
